bottleneck_assessment: The AR1 graph has a 1.596 GB constant footprint and incurs compiler-estimated multi-GB DDR read/write plus ~6 GB spill/fill per execution; metadata does not prove every constant byte is reread.
Raw FP32 attention-state input alone is ~128 MiB per execution; all 41 input tensors are host memcpy-copied into QNN buffers.
All 22 FP32 logit chunks total 512,000 bytes and are graph outputs even on prompt steps where CPU does not request argmax.
AR1 prompt latency scales almost linearly with 171 graph executions; chunked prefill is the highest-leverage first candidate.
FP16/uFxp16 state and registered/device-resident memory are subsequent levers; any hybrid route must declare every CPU/GPU boundary.
claim_boundary: Static metadata/compiler profile plus arithmetic over one accepted physical baseline. No new phone run or performance candidate result.

next_host_candidates.name: chunked_prefill_AR32
next_host_candidates.reason: Fits 171 tokens as five full chunks plus one 11-token tail if static tail variants or padding semantics are proven; reduces weight/runlist replay drastically.

physical_baseline_single_run.interpretation: One physical run; timing is diagnostic, not statistical.

runner_copy_boundary.note: DirectContext::Run memcpy-copies every input into QNN raw buffers. The graph exposes all state and 22 FP32 logit chunks as app-readable raw outputs.
